summary: {councilor} asks how someone who missed the hearing will learn that the pardon covers them.
realLife: Kennedy challenged officials to reach people unlikely to visit a portal or request a certificate on their own.
gates: Effective class pardon and an unresolved notification plan.
inGame: needs: effective class pardon and an unresolved notification plan.

turns.pulledBy: An agency has verified contact information.
turns.what: Ask it to describe a direct notice process.
turns.writesBack: The plan names a sender and the people it can reach.

turns.what: Ask which local partners can publicize the order.
turns.writesBack: The outreach plan records the remaining coverage gap.
